mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged despite CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 5% signals a tightening labor market, which leads to wage inflation and increased production costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged despite UNRATE < 5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals growing demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged despite increasing HOUST.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average signals increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged despite INDPRO > 12-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a rise in GDP (GDPC1) signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged despite FEDFUNDS decrease & GDPC1 increase.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong labor market conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns remain negative or unchanged despite PAYEMS > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail sales (RSAFS) below its 6-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged despite RSAFS < 6-month MA.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) coupled with a decrease in GDP (GDPC1) signals tightening monetary policy and economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns remain positive or unchanged despite FEDFUNDS increase & GDPC1 decrease.
